structured_output.summary: Approve. The draft covers B09's scope and done_when using only the motion values in UI_RULES §7 and board 05 #2, #3 and #9. Each criterion is a computed-style or DOM-text check on a new stage in Chromium, it retires no code, and no open PR touches its files. The remaining notes are minor and go to the builder.

findings.claim: Board 05 #3 says the lap panel stamps from 1.18 to 1 'with shadow 6→3px'. The draft only mentions the scale. Board 05 #9 also says the controls slide 'up' and the top panels 'down'. The draft says 'from their own edge', which is right, but AC5 doesn't check the direction.
findings.suggestedFix: Builder: have the lap-stamp keyframes go from scale(1.18) with a 6px offset shadow to the normal 3px shadow, built from tokens (box-shadow offset is an allowed property). Slide the top-left and top-right panels down from above and the touch slots up from below, using translate in the keyframes.

findings.claim: Board 05 #9 says the HUD panels slide in 'after the wipe … before the countdown'. B08 (#30, in flight) adds a chequer band on entering a race, and its state changes happen at once under that overlay. Once #30 merges, an entry that starts at reset may play hidden under the band. Main has no wipe today, so building the entry at reset now is correct and visible. The draft already notes this.
findings.suggestedFix: Builder: start the entry from reset() (or the first countdown sync) through one function, so that whichever of B08 and B09 merges second can delay it until the band clears without touching these tests. AC5 and AC6 only read stage state, so they stay valid either way.

findings.claim: AC4 needs the bump, roll and stamp classes cleared in sim time (raceTick), not on animationend, or the frozen-time stage can't show animation-name none. A second position change while the bump class is still on must also restart the animation, and no criterion covers that.
findings.suggestedFix: Builder: follow the NEW BEST chip pattern in race-ui.ts. Record the raceTick of the last position or lap change and clear the class ceil(duration×60/1000) ticks later. On a fresh change inside that window, re-apply the class so the animation restarts (for example by toggling a second keyframes name or forcing a reflow).

findings.claim: AC7's 'animation-name none' checks would also pass on main, which has no HUD animations at all. The test fails on main only because the new stage doesn't exist yet. That is unavoidable for a 'motion is cut' criterion, but on its own it proves little.
findings.suggestedFix: Builder: in the same reduced-motion test, check that the same stages under reducedMotion 'no-preference' do compute a non-none animation. That shows the media query is what removes it.

findings.claim: The draft leaves the Pos gain/loss colour cut (grass/rally-red for 600 ms, board 05 #3) to a 'later item', but no item in the backlog covers it. B09's own scope doesn't list it either, so leaving it out is correct.
findings.suggestedFix: No change to the draft. A backlog request has been raised so the colour cut isn't lost.

structured_output.overlapAssessment: The harness reports no file overlap. The only diff in /inputs is pr-29.diff, which touches guardrails/manifest.json, tests/baselines/bot-laps.json and a new game test, none of them HUD files. B08 (#30) is in flight with no files listed. It is linked to this item only through board 05 #9's 'after the wipe' order, which is noted as a minor finding. Building the entry at reset is correct on main today.
backlogChangeRequests: Add a backlog item for the HUD Pos panel colour cut on a position change (board 05 #3: the fill cuts to grass on a gain or rally-red on a loss for 600 ms). Neither B09 nor any other item covers it.
After B08 (#30) and B09 both merge, a follow-up should make the HUD entry slide (B09) start only once the B08 chequer band has cleared, per board 05 #9 ('after the wipe … before the countdown').
